run_launch_with_gnome_terminal: run launch_with_gnome_terminal to launch commands in gnome-terminal with optional tab support
run_launch_with_gnome_terminal_tabs: run launch_with_gnome_terminal_tabs to launch each command in a separate gnome-terminal tab
run_launch_with_gnome_terminal_windows: run launch_with_gnome_terminal_windows to launch each command in a separate gnome-terminal window
run_find_gnome_terminal_server: run find_gnome_terminal_server to probe multiple system paths for gnome-terminal-server location
run_launch_with_gnome_terminal_v2: run launch_with_gnome_terminal with LP_WORKER_MANAGER_V2 flag to use worker_manager_v2 for process management
